Assistant monitoring
Shows while Live AI Reply is watching selected chat apps. Use Stop to switch everything off.
Reads visible text in chat apps you select and can insert replies when you explicitly allow it.

Live AI Reply uses Android Accessibility Service to read visible conversation text only in the app package names you select, detect a new incoming message, identify the message composer, and generate a suggested reply. Recent visible chat text may be sent to the AI endpoint you configure after sensitive values are redacted.

Suggest is the default: it never types or sends automatically. Approve can place a suggestion in the identified composer but does not press Send until you do. Auto can insert a generated reply and activate a labelled Send control only after a separate in-app opt-in that explains this automation. Coordinate gestures and key-event filtering are not enabled.

The app does not need passwords, OTPs, PINs, banking information, or payment information. Password/credential fields, sensitive screens, banking/authenticator packages and your excluded package list are skipped. Outbound filtering redacts OTPs, passwords, PINs, card numbers, CVVs, bank-account values and authentication codes before an AI request.

Screen capture is separate, optional and off by default. Each one-shot OCR fallback requires Android's normal MediaProjection confirmation; recognition runs on-device, the image is discarded, and FLAG_SECURE content is excluded by Android without any workaround.

STOP AI immediately stops monitoring and automated replies, removes the optional overlay and releases OCR/screen capture.
Live AI Reply is a conversation assistant, not an accessibility tool for people with disabilities. Android therefore treats this service as a non-accessibility-tool service.
Security and privacy disclosure

Live AI Reply can read visible text from the apps you choose so it can understand conversations and generate replies. Text may be sent to your selected AI provider. The app does not need passwords, OTPs, PINs, banking information, or payment information.

Accessibility is the core feature. Android grants the service access to window content, but Live AI Reply restricts event delivery and processing to package names you enable. Password fields, credential/payment screens, sensitive packages and excluded apps are skipped. Suggest mode is the default. Approve or separately opted-in Auto mode may insert text and use a labelled Send control; coordinate gestures and key-event filtering are disabled.

Display over other apps is optional and off by default. If you grant Android\'s overlay permission and turn on the in-app switch, a floating status/suggestion control appears over a selected chat. You can turn it off or use STOP AI at any time.
A foreground service runs only after you turn Monitoring on and shows a persistent notification with Pause and Stop. It does not start merely because Accessibility was enabled.

Screen capture / OCR is optional and off by default. Each one-shot fallback starts only after you tap Authorize and approve Android\'s normal MediaProjection dialog. One frame is recognised on-device and discarded immediately; screenshots are never stored or uploaded. Android excludes FLAG_SECURE content and this app has no workaround.

Before any AI request, the app redacts OTPs, passwords, PINs, card numbers, CVVs, bank-account values and authentication codes. Remaining recent chat text and reply instructions go only to the AI endpoint you select. That provider processes them under its own terms. The API key is encrypted with Android Keystore and is not logged or backed up.
I understand and agree
Read the disclosure above and select “I understand and agree” before opening sensitive system settings.
Battery optimisation is optional. This app opens Android\'s general battery settings and does not request the restricted REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS permission.
